CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_Sector_CRM
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_Sector
AS(
    SELECT
     BCC.[VALUE] AS SectorCode
    ,BCC.DESCRIPTION  AS SectorName
    ,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCC.CATEGORYID AS CategoryId
    ,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES_DELTA BCCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES BCC ON BCCD.CATEGORYID = BCC.CATEGORYID AND BCCD.BANK_ID = BCC.BANK_ID AND BCC.ISLATEST = 1 AND CATEGORYTYPE = 'SECTOR_CODE'
 WHERE BCC.CATEGORYID IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_Sector FROM TEMP_BNKM_Sector;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_Sector_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
SectorCode
,SectorName
,FinancialInstitutionId 
,CategoryId 
)) HASHROW, SectorCode,FinancialInstitutionId, RECORD_STATUS ,CATEGORYID
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_Sector WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_Sector_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
SectorCode
,SectorName
,FinancialInstitutionId 
,CategoryId 
)) HASHROW, SectorCode, FinancialInstitutionId ,CATEGORYID
FROM BNKM.Sector --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CRM'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_Sector_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.SectorCode,TGT.SectorCode) AS SectorCode
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CATEGORYID,TGT.CATEGORYID) AS CATEGORYID
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_Sector_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_Sector_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.SectorCode = TGT.SectorCode
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.CATEGORYID = TGT.CATEGORYID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_Sector_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_Sector_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 SectorCode  = SRC.SectorCode 
,SectorName  = SRC.SectorName 
,CategoryId  = SRC.CategoryId 
FROM BNKM.Sector TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Sector_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.SectorCode = TGT.SectorCode AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.CATEGORYID = TGT.CATEGORYID AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Sector SRC ON SRC.SectorCode = TGT.SectorCode AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.CATEGORYID = TGT.CATEGORYID ;
 

----INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.Sector
([SectorCode]
,[SectorName]
,[SectorDescription]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CategoryId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm] )

SELECT
     SectorCode AS SectorCode
    ,SectorName AS SectorName
    ,NULL AS SectorDescription
    ,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,CategoryId AS CategoryId
    ,SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_Sector
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_Sector;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_Sector_DELTA;

END
